remarks: Nestled away on a quiet street in the sought after Mid-Ridges neighborhood. This charming 3 bedroom 2 full bath Ranch style home has a cozy living room that features hardwood floors and fireplace also open to the dining room. There are endless possibilities for your personal touch in the fully equip kitchen. The bedrooms are generous size rooms with lots of natural light. You'll love the welcoming feel of the spacious bright and open family room set off of the kitchen. The large family room has access to the sizeable deck open to the level backyard. Convenient to shopping, dining, downtown, public transportation, Merritt Parkway and highway. *The sale is subject to probate court approval*
